slides.texte_overlay:
How to have Brad Pitt's
charisma without his looks
Be comfortable in silence. Charismatic men don't rush to fill every pause. A relaxed silence makes you look calm and in control.
Speak a little slower. Fast talking sounds nervous. A slower, lower voice makes people lean in and listen to what you say.
Keep a sense of humour about life. Light jokes, easy laughter, a playful attitude. It makes you fun to be around in any situation.
Look people in the eyes when you talk. Not staring, just steady and warm. It makes people feel seen and makes you look confident.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. A man with interesting things to say always has charisma.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A man with interesting things to say always has charisma.

slides.texte_overlay: Dress with ease. Simple pieces, good fit, nothing that looks like you're trying too hard. Effortless style starts with comfort.
Be genuinely curious about people. Ask about their lives, remember what they say. Charisma is mostly about making others feel interesting.
